description: The new inner axis predicates skip genuine reductions of full FP16 weights.
trigger: Ordinary FP16 loading receives a full weight with an axis larger than its requested local axis, including split GatedMLP projections loaded through alternate full-weight keys.
expected_behavior: Crop at the supplied offset, crop output bias when applicable, and retain the local matrix.
actual_behavior: stored < requested is false for reductions. The subsequent copy preserves the full shape. Gate/up matrices disagree with allocated output width; down matrices disagree with local input width. No downstream crop repairs them.

verification.description: Inspected both direct constructor callers and GatedMLP's full-size/offset preparation. Reach is conditional on loading full FP16 weights rather than already-local or EXL3 weights.
Modeled the changed axis-selection predicates with Python lists; a 512-to-256 reduction retained 512 indices.

introductions.rationale: The changed constructor predicates introduce this condition; both direct callers were checked in the approved annotation.
